warnings: Pile caps on I-section piles I 0.22x0.22 m. (SAFE LOAD 23 ตัน/ต้น); pile length not printed. F1 one pile, F2 two piles (both drawn in the cap plan and the section).

F2's pile callout repeats F1's wording 'มี Dowel Bar จำนวน 1 ตน' although two piles are drawn, each with its own leader — read as the per-pile dowel count; pile_count = 2 taken from the drawing (cap plan + section both show two piles, and S-01 draws F2 with a pile each side of the column).

main_bar.count is the two-way total (section 6b). F1 prints '9+9-DB16' on one leader (square 0.50 x 0.50, depth_mm omitted). F2 prints two labels: 8-DB16 on the cut bar dots (bars across the 0.50 side) and 9-DB16 on the long bottom bar (along the 1.25 side) — recorded in bars_by_direction, count 17.

Depths below ระดับดินเดิม (1.00 to the cap top, cap 0.60, lean concrete 0.05, sand 0.05) are printed against a level that carries no value, so they stay on the elements, not in the grid master's z_levels.

S1(ด้านสั้น) and S1(ด้านยาว) print the same reinforcement and thickness — merged to one entry. Bottom mesh RB9@0.20m# is main_bar; top bars RB9@0.20m over the supports (L/3 one side, L/4 the other) are additional_bars.
No concrete strength is printed on this sheet; it is on the A-01 notes.
